newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money traded at 13.0/14.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money traded at 13.0/14.0 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was traded at 13.0/14.0 percent on Tuesday on the back of sufficient rupiah supply, dealers said.
One state-owned bank dealer said early central bank injection of some 327 billion rupiah and offers from some state banks helped keep liquidity ample.
Another bank dealer said operators remained calm and this was reflected in stable rates for all periods of interbank money.
The average overnight interbank rate on Monday was 12.33 percent compared with 16.92 percent on Friday.
